annotations.text:
A · Y'ELLO BOLD
Where the app is now, tightened up.

Why: unmistakably MTN. Loud, playful, and the game feels like a game.

Trade-off: a lot of yellow to meet every single morning, and it's the busiest of the three.

B · MIDNIGHT
Dark, quiet, premium.

Why: kind to your eyes at 6am and last thing at night. Yellow is rare here, so it actually lands when it appears.

Trade-off: reads less 'MTN' at a glance, and the quiz feels calm rather than fun.

C · ALMANAC
A printed daily almanac.

Why: content first and timeless. It reads like a proper briefing you sit down with, not an app.

Trade-off: the quietest of the three; the word game has to work harder to feel playful.
